title: Reports
subtitle: Operational, inventory, and financial reports for posted transactions.
snapshot_note: This report is based on the current stock snapshot.

groups.cash_flow_description: Cash and bank inflow and outflow reports.
groups.party_description: Customer and supplier balance movement reports.
groups.operations_description: Operational sales and purchase line reports.
groups.expenses_description: Expense transaction reports by category and account.
groups.inventory_description: Current stock, valuation, and movement reports.
groups.management_description: User activity and operational oversight reports.

table.no_data: No report data found for the selected filters.

messages.ledger_required: Select a ledger to view this report.
messages.customer_required: Select a customer to view this statement.
messages.supplier_required: Select a supplier to view this statement.
messages.account_required: Select a cash or bank account to view this report.

trial_balance.label: Trial balance
trial_balance.description: Posted debit, credit, and net balance by ledger.

balance_sheet.label: Balance sheet
balance_sheet.description: Financial position up to the selected date.

income_statement.label: Profit and loss
income_statement.description: Revenue, cost of goods sold, expenses, and net profit for the selected period.

customer_statement.label: Customer statement
customer_statement.description: All customer balances by default, or a full ledger statement for a selected customer.

supplier_statement.label: Supplier statement
supplier_statement.description: All supplier balances by default, or a full ledger statement for a selected supplier.

receipt_report.label: Receipt report
receipt_report.description: Cash and bank inflows where the cash account is debited.

payment_report.label: Payment report
payment_report.description: Cash and bank outflows where the cash account is credited.

cash_book.label: Cash book
cash_book.description: Running balance for a selected cash or bank account.

cash_position_by_currency.label: Cash Position by Currency
cash_position_by_currency.description: How much cash you are holding in each currency, across all cash and bank accounts.

sales_report.label: Sales report
sales_report.description: Posted sales by customer and item. Switch between general (per invoice) and item-wise views.

purchase_report.label: Purchase report
purchase_report.description: Posted purchases by supplier and item. Switch between general (per invoice) and item-wise views.

inventory_stock.label: Inventory stock
inventory_stock.description: Current stock quantity and value by item and warehouse.

stock_movement.label: Stock movement
stock_movement.description: Detailed stock movement history by item and warehouse.

low_stock.label: Low stock
low_stock.description: Items at or below their reorder level.

inventory_valuation.label: Inventory valuation
inventory_valuation.description: Current inventory value grouped by item.

batch_wise_report.label: Batch wise report
batch_wise_report.description: Current batch quantities with in, out, and on hand totals by batch.

expiry_wise_report.label: Expiry wise report
expiry_wise_report.description: Current expiry-based quantities with in, out, and on hand totals.

zero_on_hand_report.label: Items with zero on hand
zero_on_hand_report.description: Items that currently have zero stock, plus lifetime in and out totals.

fast_moving_report.label: Fast moving report
fast_moving_report.description: Items with the highest sales quantity and sale frequency.

slow_moving_report.label: Slow moving report
slow_moving_report.description: Items with the lowest sales movement and stock turnover.

today_sale_purchase_closing_stock_report.label: Today's sale, purchase & closing stock
today_sale_purchase_closing_stock_report.description: Opening balance, today's purchases, today's sales, and closing balance by item.

near_expiry_report.label: Near expiry report
near_expiry_report.description: Items and batches expiring within the next 30 days.

maximum_stock_report.label: Maximum stock report
maximum_stock_report.description: Items whose current stock is above the defined maximum stock level.

group_summary_report.label: Group summary report
group_summary_report.description: Accounts grouped by account type with opening, debit, credit, and closing balances.

day_book_report.label: Day book
day_book_report.description: Posted transaction lines for the selected date range.

journal_book_report.label: Journal book
journal_book_report.description: Total debit, credit, and balance grouped by account type.

user_activity.label: User activity
user_activity.description: Logins and create, update, and delete activity by user.

expense_report.label: Expense report
expense_report.description: Posted expenses by date, category, expense account, and bank account.

payroll_register.label: Payroll register
payroll_register.description: Every payslip in the period, with days worked, earnings, tax and what has been paid.

payslip_summary.label: Payroll summary
payslip_summary.description: One line per payroll run — headcount, gross, tax and what is still owed.

tax_withholding_report.label: Wage tax withheld
tax_withholding_report.description: Tax deducted per employee, with the tax table each payslip was computed against.

employee_loan_statement.label: Employee loans
employee_loan_statement.description: Staff loans and advances, what has been recovered and what is still outstanding.

attendance_summary.label: Attendance summary
attendance_summary.description: Days present, late, absent and on leave per employee, with hours worked.

attendance_register.label: Attendance register
attendance_register.description: The day-by-day attendance record, with check-in and check-out times.

leave_balance_report.label: Leave balances
leave_balance_report.description: Entitlement against days taken. Pending requests are shown but not deducted.

leave_register.label: Leave register
leave_register.description: Individual leave requests, their dates and who approved them.

headcount_report.label: Headcount
headcount_report.description: Staff numbers by department as at the end of the period, with joiners and leavers.

contract_expiry_report.label: Contract expiry
contract_expiry_report.description: Contracts ending in the period, so renewals and notice periods are not missed.

home_equivalent_note: Home-currency equivalent ({code}), converted at each transaction's own rate
